name: ODYSSEY 10 · THE BEWITCHING QUEEN OF AEAEA

rows.t: Weave and shine, weave and shine — so runs the thread, so runs the world.

rows.t: Go in if you must. I smell a snare in all this sweetness — I stay outside.

x_odyssey.delivery: hidden observer freezing in dread, then fleeing without entering

rows.t: Drink deep, strangers — cheese and barley, pale honey, Pramnian wine. Now the wand: go to the sty where you belong.

x_odyssey.delivery: beautiful singing host becoming precise alchemist, wand operator, and jailer

rows.t: They took on the bristles and snouts and bodies of swine — but their minds stayed human, and they wept, remembering.

x_odyssey.payload: The men become pigs in body while retaining human minds
x_odyssey.delivery: frame the action without replacing character agency
reveal: The men become pigs in body while retaining human minds

rows.t: In with you. Acorns and cornel-berries — the proper food of what you are now.

x_odyssey.delivery: beautiful singing host becoming precise alchemist, wand operator, and jailer
reveal: Circe shuts them in pens and throws them acorns

rows.t: They are gone, Odysseus — all of them! They went in at the shining doors and not one came out. I waited long, and called, and no man answered.

x_odyssey.delivery: hidden observer freezing in dread, then fleeing without entering

x_odyssey.payload: Circe recognizes the foretold man, kneels, and offers her bed

rows.t: The bristles fell away, and they stood up men again — younger than before, taller, and fairer to look upon.

x_odyssey.payload: The swine regain human form, younger and more handsome than before

conceal: full recognition until required private evidence is supplied

rows.t: Go — he is here.

rows.t: Even my heart, which does not melt, is moved. Go down, beach your ship and bring the rest of your men — my halls will hold you all.

x_odyssey.payload: even Circe is moved

conceal: full recognition until required private evidence is supplied
reveal: even Circe is moved

rows.t: Haul the ship high and follow me — your shipmates sit feasting alive in Circe's hall. Eurylochus cries snare and ruin; I say the danger is past, and hanging back now costs more than you fear.

rows.t: Sit, eat your meat and drink your wine, day upon day, till the heart comes back into your chests.

rows.t: Circe, keep now the promise that you made me: send me home. My own heart strains for Ithaca, and my men's hearts with mine — will you loose us at last?

x_odyssey.delivery: shocked listener accepting a mission no living sailor would choose
reveal: Odysseus asks Circe to honor her promise of homeward passage

rows.t: To the house of Death? Before Ithaca I must sail down to Hades and question blind Tiresias of Thebes? Then that is the road, though it breaks every heart aboard.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.odysseus
x_odyssey.payload: She says he must first consult Tiresias in the land of the dead
x_odyssey.delivery: shocked listener accepting a mission no living sailor would choose
reveal: She says he must first consult Tiresias in the land of the dead

rows.t: Set your mast and sit still — the North Wind will carry you across Ocean to Persephone's grove of poplar and willow. There dig a trench a cubit square, and pour to all the dead honey and milk, sweet wine, water, and white barley. Bleed a ram and a black ewe into it — the dead will come, but hold them from the blood until Tiresias has drunk.

x_odyssey.speaker: character.circe
x_odyssey.payload: Circe gives directions to Ocean's edge and the ritual for summoning spirits
x_odyssey.direction: maps the road to the dead
x_odyssey.delivery: unresisting guide who replaces the hoped-for route home with a darker necessary route
reveal: Circe gives directions to Ocean's edge and the ritual for summoning spirits

rows.t: The ship — wait —

rows.t: They put out grieving for a road no living ship should sail — and behind the dark prow Circe sent a fair following wind, a good companion.

x_odyssey.payload: The crew launches in grief while Circe sends a favorable wind
